result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but it features wide turning radii and significant crossing distances. The environment is dominated by asphalt with minimal physical protection for pedestrians beyond basic signalization and paint.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with marked crosswalks and a dedicated bike lane, though it lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is primarily residential and commercial with continuous sidewalks, but the wide turning radius and lack of signalized pedestrian protection increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: There are no visible pedestrian-specific signal heads at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection of Ann St and the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner design allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of conflict with pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extension (Bulbout)
interventions.description: Install a curb extension to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a residential/commercial intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk. However, the environment is compromised by significant visual obstructions from parked cars near the corner and a lack of traffic control for the side street.

hazards.name: Daylighting Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located very close to the intersection, severely limiting sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the side street approach

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No visible stop sign or traffic signal controls the intersection for the side street, creating ambiguity in right-of-way.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway near the crossing area could pose a trip hazard or affect vehicle handling.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection and install curb extensions to improve visibility and shorten crossing distance.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
interventions.description: Install a stop sign or all-way stop control to clarify right-of-way at the crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse markings to a high-visibility continental pattern.
